approved_command_preview: Rerun the same approved canonical per-file review candidate with only the patch-exporter fix that includes the new untracked canonical file in git diff. No source-branch mutation, provider calls, review trigger, Ready transition, or merge.
command:
$payload='.github/chatgpt_staging/exec_payloads/issue550-pr553-canonical-per-file-review-candidate-001.py.gz.b64'; $script=Join-Path $env:RUNNER_TEMP 'issue550-per-file-candidate-002.py'; python -c "import base64,gzip,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(r'$payload'); s=gzip.decompress(base64.b64decode(p.read_text())).decode(); s=s.replace('issue550-pr553-canonical-per-file-review-candidate-001','issue550-pr553-canonical-per-file-review-candidate-002').replace('ISSUE550_PR553_CANONICAL_PER_FILE_REVIEW_CANDIDATE_001_PASS','ISSUE550_PR553_CANONICAL_PER_FILE_REVIEW_CANDIDATE_002_PASS'); old='    run("git", "diff", "--check", cwd=worktree)
    patch = run("git", "diff", "--binary", cwd=worktree).stdout
'; new='    run("git", "add", "-N", ".github/dcoir_review/scripts/dcoir_review/per_file_review.py", cwd=worktree)
    run("git", "diff", "--check", cwd=worktree)
    patch = run("git", "diff", "--binary", cwd=worktree).stdout
'; assert old in s; s=s.replace(old,new,1); pathlib.Path(r'$script').write_text(s)"; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }; python $script
